title: 19 树鬼卵20 长香者21 亲饲鬼
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：“是啊。”
大张护卫点点头，幽幽的道。
“据说那大树村地势偏僻，距离大启城最远，往往每去一趟大启城都需要差不多三天的时间，再加上穷困，久而久之，不少术师都不愿意前去大树村。”
“直到某一天，一位年轻的术师来到大树村。”
“因为有了术师，大树村因为之前术师离开造成的阴霾也渐渐消失，新来的术师脾气也很好，术式天赋也很强，不少大树村村民都十分信奉这位术师。”
“唯一古怪的是这位术师信奉一位叫做树鬼母的诡物。”
“树母鬼是一种十分罕见的诡物，大多都是黄厉级以上，少部分极为强大的树鬼母甚至可以达到青幽级，捕猎一般都靠她所诞下的树鬼卵，大树村的运气十分好，来到他们村落的这只树鬼母是黄厉级的。”
“大树村是被那只树鬼母害的吗？”
小张护卫听入迷了，完全没有想为什么自己的哥哥突然知道这么多的事情，眼看大张护卫只说一半话，他就忍不住追问下去。
其他人则察觉到了不对劲。
贺堪看着篝火对面的大张护卫，现在夜色深沉，黑暗无比，只有面前的篝火是光亮的，大张护卫又是低头说话，根本看不清他的表情。
“自然是的。”
大张护卫似乎完全没有看见周围的气氛逐渐变冷，他似乎完全沉浸在自己讲的故事当中，语气幽幽的道：“树鬼卵，每一只树鬼卵都需要一个活生生的人类，由树鬼母亲自将自己的卵产在人类的体内。”
“一开始，那些村民只是听从了术师的话，认为这是“树母”
的赐福，一个接着一个接受了赐福，那些树鬼卵就在他们体内生长，内脏被树卵吃掉，慢慢的，他们的意识也逐渐由树鬼卵接替。”
“那个村落成为了诡物的巢穴。”
“传说中，那些树鬼卵的外表与普通人类一模一样，意识也完全相同，根本看不出任何区别，唯一的区别就在与他们脑后的一寸的地方，有一条狭长的缝隙，树鬼卵正是从那条缝隙中钻进去的。”
大张护卫说的时候，不知道什么时候，嘴角轻轻勾起，一双眼睛亮的诡异。
小张护卫这个时候，再怎么沉迷都反应过来了，他哥不对劲。
大张护卫作为一个小村落出来的护卫，即使会几手家传功夫，见识却绝对一般，不可能大张护卫知道的事情小张护卫不清楚。

更重要的是，大树村已经全部都被树鬼母诞下的树鬼卵吃了。
那大张护卫到底是怎么知道的？
“你不是我哥，你到底是什么东西？”
小张护卫立刻站起来厉声喝问，长刀横在身前，一双虎目紧紧盯住大张护卫，随后护卫着商队管事往后退，幸头领早已经将武器拿在手中，贺堪更不用说，早在大张护卫说起大树村这个故事的时候，他就已经握紧手中青铜矛了。
贺堪一直不动手也不过时想看清楚这大张护卫到底是个什么东西。
“我？”
大张护卫终于抬起头，整个面庞都露了出来，还是大张护卫的脸，表情却怎么看怎么诡异，一双眼睛直直的看向小张护卫，嘴角弧度诡异，道：“我当然是树鬼卵啊。”
大张护卫是扭头看向小张护卫的。
其他人都往后面避开，其他人听见这边的动静，特别是发现大张护卫不对领的时候，所有篝火附近的人都出现了行动。
商队管事机灵的躲在幸头领的身后。
贺堪也在这附近，正好背对“大张护卫”
，贺堪清晰的看见对方脖子的地方有一条狭长的白色缝隙，边缘是白色的，那像是个大的口袋，口袋里面好像有什么东西在活动。

: "Yes."
Guard Da Zhang nodded and said quietly.
"It is said that Dashu Village is remote and farthest from Daqi City. It usually takes almost three days to go to Daqi City. Coupled with poverty, many magicians are unwilling to go to Dashu Village over time."
"Until one day, a young magician came to Dashu Village."
"Because of the magician, the haze caused by the previous magician's departure in Dashu Village has gradually disappeared. The new magician has a good temper and is very talented in magic. Many villagers in Dashu Village believe in this magician."
"The only weird thing is that this magician believes in a strange creature called the Tree Ghost Mother."
"The tree ghost is a very rare monster. Most of them are Huang Li level or above. A few extremely powerful tree ghost mothers can even reach the Qingyou level. Hunting usually relies on the tree ghost eggs she gives birth to. Dashu Village is very lucky. The tree ghost mother that came to their village is of the Huang Li level."
"Was Dashu Village harmed by the tree ghost mother?"
Guard Zhang was fascinated by what he heard. He didn't even think about why his brother suddenly knew so many things. Seeing that Guard Zhang only spoke half of the words, he couldn't help but ask more questions.
Others sensed something was wrong.
He Kan looked at Guard Da Zhang opposite the bonfire. The night was now deep and extremely dark. Only the bonfire in front of him was bright. Guard Da Zhang lowered his head to speak, and could not see his expression clearly.
"Of course it is."
Da Zhangwei didn't seem to notice that the atmosphere around him was gradually getting colder. He seemed to be completely immersed in the story he was telling, and said in a faint tone: "Tree ghost eggs, every tree ghost egg needs a living human being, and the tree ghost mother will lay her own eggs in the human body."
"At first, the villagers just listened to the magician and thought it was the "Tree Mother"
After accepting the blessings one after another, the tree ghost eggs grew in their bodies, and their internal organs were eaten by the tree eggs. Slowly, their consciousness was gradually taken over by the tree ghost eggs. "
"That village became a lair for monsters."
"According to legend, the appearance of those tree ghost eggs is exactly the same as that of ordinary humans, and their consciousness is exactly the same. There is no difference at all. The only difference is that there is a narrow gap one inch behind their heads, and the tree ghost eggs get in through that gap."
When Guard Zhang said that, he didn't know when, the corners of his mouth slightly raised, and his eyes were strangely bright.
At this time, Guard Xiao Zhang realized that something was wrong with his brother no matter how obsessed he was.
As a guard from a small village, Guard Zhang had some mediocre knowledge even though he knew some family kung fu. It was impossible for Guard Zhang to know things that Guard Zhang didn't know.
What's more important is that all the trees in Dashu Village have been eaten by the tree ghost eggs born by the tree ghost mother.
So how did Guard Zhang know?
"You're not my brother, what on earth are you?"
Guard Xiao Zhang immediately stood up and shouted sternly, holding his long knife in front of him, staring at guard Da Zhang with a pair of tiger eyes, and then escorting the caravan steward back. Leader Xing had already held the weapon in his hand, not to mention He Kan, who had already grasped the bronze spear in his hand when guard Da Zhang told the story of Dashu Village.
He Kan had never done anything, and there were times when he wanted to see clearly what this big guard was.
"Me?"
Guard Zhang finally raised his head, and his whole face was revealed. It was still Guard Zhang's face, but his expression looked weird. He looked straight at Guard Zhang with his eyes, and the corners of his mouth curved in a weird way, and said, "Of course I am a tree ghost egg."
Guard Zhang turned to look at guard Zhang.
Everyone else moved back. When others heard the movement, especially when they discovered that Da Zhang was not leading the guard, everyone near the bonfire took action.
The caravan manager cleverly hid behind XingtouBehind the collar.
He Kan was also nearby, with his back facing "Dazhang Guards"
, He Kan clearly saw a narrow white gap on the other side's neck, with a white edge. It looked like a big pocket, and something seemed to be moving inside the pocket.
